Q5460.reason: The painter’s blame of coworkers for the wall is not a vicarious admission because that structural work was outside his own job and he was not a participant in the negligence, so the hearsay objection is sustained.

Q8222.reason: Six weeks after a kidney transplant with OKT3 induction, fever, fatigue, and cold symptoms fit EBV (mono-like illness / early PTLD risk), alongside suspected graft rejection.

Q5849.reason: Testimony that computer records were kept on a regular business basis does not meet the full Rule 803(6) or authentication foundation, so the court will require more proof of reliability.
